bio: Take a break from exploring the historic city of Bath, and unwind at the beautiful Roseate Villa with a delicious Afternoon Tea. Tucked away in a peaceful haven just a short walk away from the centre, this elegant space is a perfect retreat.  Afternoon Tea is served in the Henrietta Room, a warm and welcoming environment that features wondrous views of over the Henrietta Park.  Their Afternoon Tea menu is a quintessential execution of the great British ritual with indulgent finger sandwiches that can be enjoyed before tucking in to freshly baked scones and a selection of exquisite hand-made pastries.  The Roseate Villa is situated around a 7 minute walk away from Bath Railway Station.
